defect_observations.detail: The verbatim inherited definition of R^* ('the least reflexive and transitive relation ...') and the first half of the lemma proof (l.23-24, 'since R^* is the least such relation') presuppose that a least such relation exists for arbitrary R; nothing on the 5.5 route states its existence (handbook/annex/p01/equivalence-closure-and-quotients.tex l.74-82 establishes it only for R union R^{-1}). The induction at l.37-44 uses only reflexivity, transitivity and R subset R^*, so it would show S is least for any such relation, but the text does not draw that conclusion.
